preconditions.description: The graph has between 2 and 10^5 vertices (n) and between 1 and 10^5 edges (m).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(u) <= n and 1 <= int(v) <= n and u != v for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+m] for u, v in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= n and x != y for line in stdin.splitlines()[m+2:m+2+k] for x, y in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each query pair (x_i, y_i) consists of two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: k == len([line for line in stdin.splitlines()[m+2:] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: The number of queries (k) matches the number of query lines provided.
The graph has no multiple edges (each edge appears exactly once).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+m])
preconditions.description: All edge vertices are within the valid range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.strip().split()) == 1 and 0 <= int(line.strip()) <= 10**9 + 6 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line contains a single integer representing the number of distinct simple paths modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) <= 10**9 + 6 for i in range(k))
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) == count_simple_paths(xi, yi, graph) % (10**9 + 7) for i, (xi, yi) in enumerate([tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[m+2:m+2+k]]))
postconditions.description: For each query (x_i, y_i), the output is the number of distinct simple paths from x_i to y_i modulo 10^9 + 7, where count_simple_paths is a function that computes this value for a vertex cactus graph.
